hooks.command: cmd=$(cat | sed -n 's/.*"command"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+push' && ! echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'CLAUDE_PUSH_REVIEWED=1'; then echo '⚠️ Revue de code requise avant toute poussée. Lancez le skill /push-review.'; exit 2; fi; exit 0
